name: Adaptive Strategy Selection
purpose: Select the currently preferred strategy by comparing evidence, learning value, readiness, risk, effort, reversibility and known cognitive limitations.
principle: NØX should not merely execute a strategy; it should choose the strategy currently best supported by its knowledge while preserving alternatives and conditions for changing course.

preferred_strategy.purpose: Observe real outcomes related to ACT28 predictions and compare them with anticipated outcomes.
reasons: It addresses the largest currently identified cognitive needs: prediction_verification, evidence_collection
It has high learning value relative to its risk and effort.
It is reversible and does not require permanent commitment.
Its selection is supported by evidence already produced by ACT26-ACT29 rather than by an unsupported assumption.
switch_conditions: verification repeatedly produces little new information
a higher-value actionable opportunity appears with adequate evidence
new evidence materially changes the current ranking
observed outcomes contradict the assumptions supporting the strategy
security, authorization or operational constraints change
another strategy produces a substantially higher evidence-adjusted score

alternatives.why_not_preferred_now: Lower current evidence-adjusted strategic score than verify_predictions.
when_it_should_be_reconsidered: confidence calibration becomes stable across repeated observations
prediction errors reveal a more important capability gap
a strategy with materially greater learning or operational value appears

alternatives.why_not_preferred_now: Lower current evidence-adjusted strategic score than verify_predictions.
when_it_should_be_reconsidered: attention selection becomes stable and sufficiently selective
a stronger prediction or reasoning gap appears
additional information intake stops improving decisions

alternatives.why_not_preferred_now: Lower current evidence-adjusted strategic score than verify_predictions.
when_it_should_be_reconsidered: relationship hypotheses receive sufficient independent support
new observations expose a more important uncertainty

alternatives.why_not_preferred_now: Lower current evidence-adjusted strategic score than verify_predictions.
when_it_should_be_reconsidered: security or authorization conditions are unclear
prediction reliability is too weak for the proposed action
a safer experiment provides greater learning value

self_awareness_implications: The chosen strategy is provisional rather than permanent.
NØX must observe results before treating the strategy as validated.
NØX should retain alternatives instead of collapsing uncertainty into one answer.
A strategy change should be triggered by evidence or changed conditions.
important_boundary: ACT30 does not claim that the preferred strategy is objectively optimal. It is the current best-supported candidate given the evidence available at this moment.
autonomy_boundary: Strategy selection does not authorize payments, spending, financial commitments or irreversible external actions. Operational actions remain subject to the capabilities and authorization available to NØX.
next_cognitive_step: ACT31 should evaluate the actual performance of selected strategies against their expected outcomes and determine which strategies reliably produce useful results.
